lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadowed pixels immediately ventral.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs, primarily localized toward the base and anterior edge of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-toned silhouettes (remoras) attached or proximal to the ventral-lateral region.
